title: Flails
description: a mod that adds flails, a new weapon type which you swing around you in an orbit !!
body:
## Flails !

![Swinging2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef4c6c550ce28d03c376db9c505e05852993cf50.gif)

This mods adds a new weapon, the flail! It deals roughly the same amount of damage as an iron sword, but you swing it around you in an orbit, able to strike multiple enemies at once. Why target a single enemy with a measly sword when the flail will crush them all?

## Enchantments

This mod also adds a new enchantment, called Crushing. It will cause the Flail to break shields on hit, like an axe.

The Flail can also be enchanted with knockback.
